title: Hugging Face 与 AWS Trainium 深度集成，TorchNeuron 公测版今日上线
summary: 本周两条实质性产品更新落地：Hugging Face 正式推出 TorchNeuron 原生后端，将 Transformers/Diffusers 开箱即用支持率从 46% 提升至 89%；OpenAI 发布低资源编程语言编程研究进展，覆盖 Fortran、SQLite 等场景。
summary_en: Hugging Face launched TorchNeuron, a native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium, now in public beta as of October 20, 2026. Transformers and Diffusers natively support the Neuron device, raising out-of-the-box support for top-100 text-generation architectures from 46% to 89%. OpenAI published research on advancing coding capabilities for low-resource programming languages like Fortran and SQLite.
body:
本周两条实质性产品更新落地：Hugging Face 正式推出 TorchNeuron 原生后端，将 Transformers/Diffusers 开箱即用支持率从 46% 提升至 89%；OpenAI 发布低资源编程语言编程研究进展，覆盖 Fortran、SQLite 等场景。

🤗 Hugging Face
- TorchNeuron: running HF models on AWS Trainium is easier than ever — TorchNeuron 公测今日上线，Transformers 开箱即用支持率从 46% 跃至 89%，Trainium 首次以原生设备身份融入 PyTorch 生态。
  https://huggingface.co/blog/hf-torchneuron

🤖 OpenAI
- Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages — 聚焦 Fortran、SQLite 等低资源语言场景的代码模型研究，扩展 AI 编程能力边界（10 月 19 日新发布）。
  https://openai.com/index/low-resource-programming-languages

Source: https://huggingface.co/blog/hf-torchneuron
